title: Pre-Vote responses of an earlier round are counted by a later round with the same probe; after a membership change grant_by panics
cause: does_pre_candidate_vote_match correlates Pre-Vote responses only by the probed leader id, which successive rounds at the same term share.
trigger: Two operator Pre-Vote rounds (trigger().elect(true)) at the same term while a grant of the first is in flight; for the crash, a membership change removing that responder between the rounds.
consequence: The later round counts the earlier round's grant; with the responder removed, Candidate::grant_by panics and the RaftCore dies.
premises: Operator-triggered Pre-Vote rounds are not rate limited.
A Pre-Vote response can be delayed up to election_timeout_min.
